description:
From a tree well that swallows skiers head first to a drop of tree resin that kept two mites for 230 million years, these are the natural traps that hold you the longest: slot canyon flash floods, the brinicle, avalanches, Dead Sea sinkholes, glacier crevasses, the La Brea Tar Pits, the Altamura cave and amber. Doug checked into every one.

Which trap should Doug check into next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next terrible holiday.
